scope: Cohort fixed by legacy opposite-sign and proxy ordinary PNG corrected sign; not selected by component magnitude.
Raw sign and the pre-existing 2/255 numeric scale are separate columns. Applying display threshold magnitude to linear radiance is diagnostic only, not a formal display classification.
Individual component and Combined-minus-one-component tests are computed without sequential summation order attribution.
Leave-one-out linear radiance is not a rerender: no re-evaluation of adaptive sampling, GI, nonlinear display or visibility.
DirectDiffuse is not total direct light; glossy direct is a distinct retained component.
Filtered proxy and native center point differ; neither direct divergence nor leave-one-out proves a unique physical cause.
